preparation.operations: Crop source rectangle [60,140,1615,800] to remove the generated stray ruler and excess margins; enlarge with nearest-neighbor. No character pixels intentionally redrawn or recolored.

generation.layout_composition: The prepared illustration is placed intact. The local compositor adds title, five-view labels already present in art, relative ruler, shared baseline, style metadata cards, 14 exact palette swatches, and candidate badge; it does not redraw or recolor the character.

design_invariants: Tall, slim, long-limbed adult ectomorph; preserve approved age and face.
Gray swept-back hair and round brass-rimmed spectacles.
Keep the established blue/cyan suit, teal shadows, white shirt, burgundy cravat, and brown boots; palette roles remain fixed.
Preserve cane, rapier, and occult steel boomerang; violet effect only on boomerang.
Remain fully human; no monster traits or unapproved costume changes.

review_notes.visual_inspection: The five requested views are present on a clean cream sheet. Front, profile, and back share an approximate scale and baseline; the page includes a 0–7.5H ruler and metadata cards. This records presence and layout only; artistic axes remain pending. Five view headings are typeset by the shared compositor; the character illustration was not changed.
